newsitem.title: UK: Daimler sees significant advance in H2.
newsitem.headline: Daimler sees significant advance in H2.

text.p: German industrial conglomerate Daimler Benz AG said on Thursday it expected to make significant advances in the second half and improve group profit on the back of rising orders, better productivity and improved currency exchange rates.

In a statement released in London, Germany's largest company said it expected group sales to exceed 115 billion marks ($62.7 billion) in 1997, driven by all divisions, and the return on capital to "clearly" exceed the 5.2 percent figure reached at the end of 1996. Group sales totalled 106.4 billion marks last year. ($ = 1.834 German Marks)
